Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Sub: Audio recording of earnings call – Q2 FY27 – Financial Results 
 
We refer to our intimation dated October 1, 2026 informing about the conference call to be hosted by the 
Company on October 15, 2026 to discuss the financial results for the quarter and half year ended  
September 30, 2026. 
 
In this connection, pursuant to the provisions of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations, 2015, the Company has conducted Q2 FY27 Earnings Call today i.e. October 15, 2026, and 
have uploaded the audio recording on the website of the Company which can be accessed at:  
 
https://www.hdfcfund.com/about-us/financial/shareholders-presentation  
  
Kindly take the same on records. 
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours faithfully, 
For HDFC Asset Management Company Limited
